thingsToDo.title: Explore Port Everglades
thingsToDo.description: Port Everglades is a deepwater seaport in Broward County that opened in 1928 and became one of Florida’s primary cargo, petroleum, and cruise terminals. The harbor was created through major dredging and channel engineering projects that connected inland waterways to Atlantic shipping lanes. Today it ranks among the busiest cruise ports in the world by passenger traffic and also handles significant containerized freight and fuel imports for South Florida. Its location between Fort Lauderdale and Hollywood, plus direct highway and rail links, gives it an outsized role in regional logistics. The port’s opening date, throughput scale, and infrastructure footprint make it a core historical and economic landmark for the city.
